$description: Image (library wave 3, component): a picture in a frame of a fixed ratio and fit, its placeholder, its fade-in and its fallback.

image-placeholder-background.$description: The frame's fill while the picture loads (placeholder color and blur).

image-placeholder-blur.$description: placeholder="blur": how much the tiny copy is blurred.

image-placeholder-scale.$description: placeholder="blur": the tiny copy is drawn a little larger, so the blur never shows a pale edge inside the frame.

image-contain-background.$description: fit="contain": the frame's fill around the whole picture.

image-fade-duration.$description: The picture fades in over its placeholder once loaded (none with reduced motion).

image-fallback-background.$description: The fallback's fill when the picture cannot load.

image-fallback-font-family.$description: The fallback's text: the body font.

image-fallback-font-size.$description: The fallback's text: the secondary size of the type scale.

image-fallback-gap.$description: The space between the fallback's icon and its text.

image-fallback-padding.$description: The fallback's inset inside the frame.

image-fallback-min-height.$description: A frame without a ratio that fails keeps at least this height, so the fallback has room.
